newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regent Pac ends debut below issue price.
newsitem.headline: Regent Pac ends debut below issue price.

text.p: Shares of Hong Kong-based global emerging markets investment house Regent Pacific Group Ltd ended their trading debut at HK$2.60 per share, down slightly from their issue price of HK$2.62 each.
The company shares moved in a range of HK$2.45 to HK$2.60. Volume was 60.06 million shares wroth HK$156.58 million.

"Weak debut was expected in view of its relatively cool response in flotation," said Ben Kwong, director of research at Dharmala Securities. "It was less attractive...especially when investors did not really understand about its business."
Regent Pacific offered 170.5 million shares, of which 25 percent of the issue were for initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong and 75 percent were placed internationally.
Its Hong Kong IPO was 12.1 times subscribed.
"Strong IPOs response of other new listings also diversified investors' interest in the stock," said a research manager at a local brokerage.

Regent Pacific concentrates on fund management, corporate finance, corporate investment and security brokerage. It also provides investment management and advisory services in emerging markets to institutional and professional investors worldwide.
It said the net proceed raised would be mainly used to expand its Eastern European corporate finance capability and to acquire an interest in a finance house in Europe.
As the company's focus is on Eastern Europe, demand for less U.S. interest rates sensitive stock is expected to give support to the stock in the long run, analysts said.
